description: An elementary substructure and its ambient structure satisfy exactly the same sentences.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.ElementarySubstructure.realize_sentence.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type u_1}
  [L.Structure M] (S : L.ElementarySubstructure M) (φ : L.Sentence) : ↥S ⊨ φ ↔ M ⊨ φ
